title: Ransomware Attack Prevention: A Practical, Layered Defense Strategy for Businesses
content_md: To prevent a ransomware attack, organizations need a mix of security measures instead of depending on one solution. Attackers often start their attacks through phishing, stolen login details, or unprotected services. These attacks can go through several steps, including gaining higher access, moving around in the network, stealing sensitive information, disrupting backups, and finally encrypting files.
